summary: Phase 7 of 8 complete (all four sub-phases 7.1/7.2/7.3/7.4). All 15 HasAxiom* instance registration files in Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/Instances/*.lean now discharge their fields from SchemaUnion instead of raw <Sys>Axiom/ModalAxiom constructor calls. The plan's literal mechanism (importing SchemaBridges.lean's bridge lemma directly into each registration site, e.g. schemaUnion_kTags_iff_KAxiom.mp) is architecturally blocked by a genuine import cycle: SchemaBridges.lean imports the Instances barrel, which imports every individual Instances/{sys}.lean file, so any Instances/{sys}.lean importing SchemaBridges.lean back is a cycle -- confirmed empirically via a direct lake build attempt (bad import + build cycle detected). Resolved by giving each Instances/{sys}.lean file its own private {sys}Tags_of_schemaUnion helper theorem, importing only the acyclic Cslib.Logics.Modal.ProofSystem.SchemaUnion and independently re-deriving (not copy-importing) that system's Phase-3 bridge forward direction using the same SchemaUnion.insert_iff/empty_iff elimination API and per-constructor case-split shape. Every one of the ~211 HasAxiom* fields across the 15 files now reads '({sys}Tags_of_schemaUnion <tag-witness>)' instead of a raw constructor call. S5 is the one structural special case: Instances/S5.lean defines no inductive of its own (it reuses Modal.ModalAxiom from Metalogic/DerivationTree.lean) but is still part of the barrel SchemaBridges.lean imports, so the identical cycle and identical resolution applied. All 15 target inductives (14 in Instances/*.lean plus ModalAxiom in DerivationTree.lean) are grep-confirmed still defined and completely unmodified, ready for Phase 8. Zero sorry, zero new axiom across all 15 files. Every HasAxiom* instance resolves under its original name/signature (verified by successful typeclass-directed elaboration in every scoped build -- a field-name/signature mismatch would fail to elaborate). Net line delta across the 15 files: +817/-220 (+597 net), driven entirely by the disclosed, necessary private-helper duplication; Phase 8 is expected to delete all 15 private helpers alongside their target inductives, recovering a large net deletion at that point.

deviations.phase: 7 (all sub-phases, finding recorded once at 7.1 start, applied uniformly)
deviations.description: Plan specified routing each registration field through the Phase-3 bridge lemma (e.g. schemaUnion_kTags_iff_KAxiom.mp) imported directly from SchemaBridges.lean. This is not importable from any Instances/*.lean file: SchemaBridges.lean imports the Instances barrel (Cslib.Logics.Modal.ProofSystem.Instances), which imports every individual Instances/{sys}.lean file, so the reverse import creates a genuine cycle in Lean's acyclic module dependency graph. Confirmed via a direct lake build attempt on Instances/K.lean: 'error: Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaBridges.lean: bad import Cslib.Logics.Modal.ProofSystem.Instances' plus a 'build cycle detected' diagnostic.
deviations.resolution: Each Instances/{sys}.lean file imports only Cslib.Logics.Modal.ProofSystem.SchemaUnion (verified acyclic: SchemaUnion.lean imports only Modal.Basic, Foundations.Logic.Axioms, Mathlib.Data.Finset.Basic) and gains one private theorem {sys}Tags_of_schemaUnion -- a file-local, independently re-derived (not copy-imported) reproduction of that system's Phase-3 bridge forward direction, using the same SchemaUnion.insert_iff/empty_iff elimination API and the same per-constructor case-split structure as the canonical SchemaBridges.lean bridge. Every registration field routes through this private helper instead of a raw constructor call. private scoping prevents any name collision with SchemaBridges.lean's public bridge names in any file that imports both. SchemaBridges.lean and SchemaUnion.lean were NOT modified (Preserved Assets / Phase 3 territory fully respected).
deviations.impact: Phase 7's line count is line-positive (+597 net) rather than roughly neutral, entirely due to the 15 duplicated private helpers (~15-40 lines each, larger for higher-differentiator systems like S5/D45). This is expected to reverse at Phase 8: once each inductive is redefined as def <Sys>Axiom := SchemaUnion sysTags, every private helper becomes dead code (the SchemaUnion witness becomes directly usable as <Sys>Axiom by defeq) and Phase 8 deletes all 15 helpers alongside the inductives/ModalAxiom they target, plus strips the now-unneeded wrapper call from each field.

continuation_context.next_phase_name: Delete the 15 inductives (+ ModalAxiom disposition), finalize
continuation_context.notes: Phase 8 redefines each inductive <Sys>Axiom as def <Sys>Axiom := SchemaUnion sysTags (name preserved) and resolves S5's ModalAxiom disposition per its own recorded end-state design decision. In addition to the plan's stated Phase 8 tasks, Phase 8 must also: (1) delete the 15 private {sys}Tags_of_schemaUnion helpers added in Phase 7 (dead scaffolding once the redefinition makes the SchemaUnion witness directly usable by defeq); (2) simplify each registration field from '({sys}Tags_of_schemaUnion <tag-witness>)' to the bare witness '<tag-witness>' (a small, mechanical per-field text change); (3) review whether the public import of SchemaUnion.lean added to each Instances/{sys}.lean file in Phase 7 is still needed post-redefinition (likely yes, since the def body itself references SchemaUnion) or can be simplified. This additional cleanup is the direct payback for Phase 7's line-positive net delta and should make Phase 8 close out net-line-negative overall as the plan requires.
